Build a **per-class instructor commission override** for the LIVE Soul Pilates CRM (.NET + Astro) at /opt/soulpilates, server **51.79.226.200**. ISOLATED branch, compile-verify only — no deploy-images/restart/Mongo-writes.

## Access (SAFE, never print the plaintext password)
ssh2/sftp to .200 via the platform approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`; mirror lib/sftp.ts; ssh2-sftp-client for uploads). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before EVERY command. Worktree off the latest pending branch so it ships together with client-notes + the free-private fix: `git -C /opt/soulpilates worktree add /opt/soulpilates-wt-ovr -b feature/notes-commission-override origin/feature/notes-commission` (fetch first).

## Context (from read-only audits)
Instructor commission is computed at payroll-run time per session in `PayrollService.cs`, from ARRIVED+PAID attendances, keyed to the session's instructor. There is a per-attendance verbatim field `Attendance.ImportedCommissionAmount` that payroll short-circuits to, BUT it is only written by the historical importer and not exposed. `MonthlyCommissionOverride` exists but is per-staff-per-month (wrong granularity). We want a clean PER-SESSION override.

## Feature — override this class's instructor commission
- **Model:** add an optional `decimal? CommissionOverride` to the **Session** entity (Mongo schemaless — no migration). When set, it means "the instructor earns exactly this amount for teaching this class," replacing the normal rate/tier computation for that session's instructor.
- **Payroll:** in `PayrollService.cs`, when accumulating an instructor's commission for a session, if `session.CommissionOverride` has a value, use it as that session's instructor commission INSTEAD of the per-attendee computed sum — but keep the safety that the class actually ran (only apply the override if the session has at least one ARRIVED+PAID attendee, so an empty/no-show class doesn't pay the override). Do NOT change any other commission path (comp grants, free-private fix, group/private rate calc) — the override is a clean top-level short-circuit for the one session. Make sure it's included in the payroll total + the washout + any commission breakdown the same way normal commission is.
- **Admin UI:** on the class-detail panel (`ClassDetailPanel.astro`), add an **admin-only "Override commission" control** — an amount input (VND) with Save + a Clear/reset-to-computed. Show the current state (e.g. "Commission: computed (rate/tier)" vs "Overridden: 250,000"). Persist via a new endpoint `PATCH /api/scheduling/session/{id}/commission-override` (auth-gated to admin/owner). Non-negative; clearing removes the override. Keep it visible but unobtrusive (near the instructor/Change control).
- This must let an operator open a completed class (e.g. a Sunday private) and set the instructor's commission for it to a specific value like 250,000.

## Rules & finish
- Compile-verify in throwaway `--rm` containers: `dotnet build SoulPilates.API -c Release` (dotnet/sdk:10.0) → 0 errors (ignore pre-existing Tests stub errors); `npm ci && npm run build` (node:22-alpine) → success. No Mongo writes. Remove worktree + prune.
- Commit + push `feature/notes-commission-override` (verify push stuck; re-push if the box resets it).
- Board: create a card on the Soul Pilates board (boardId `cmsavfvil000hhla4nlpuyge6`, In progress col `cmsavfvin000khla4anofdbxt`), title "Per-class instructor commission override", type FEATURE, + a "Claude" comment (model, payroll short-circuit, endpoint, UI, branch/tip, deploy note).

Report: the model + payroll change (with the "class actually ran" guard), the endpoint + UI, dotnet+astro build results, branch tip, and the prod deploy command `cd /opt/soulpilates && git fetch origin && git checkout -B main origin/feature/notes-commission-override && scripts/deploy-prod.sh` (superset — ships client-notes + free-private fix + this override).
